controls.title: Recorded activation identity
controls.recommendation: Inspect the found and installed identities. Use a release with an explicit compatibility mapping; assessment cannot migrate state.

controls.title: Managed governance file drift
controls.recommendation: Run liftoff update --check and review exact managed-core drift. Force cannot acquire unowned files or bypass compatibility.

controls.title: Default integration branch
controls.recommendation: Review the repository default branch through a separately approved governance change.

controls.title: Protected GitFlow refs
controls.recommendation: Review repository rulesets for develop, main, release/** and hotfix/** with deletion and force-push protection, strict checks, and no bypass actors.

controls.title: Single-maintainer pull request rules
controls.recommendation: Keep required approving reviews at zero, code-owner review false, and last-push approval false. Automated checks remain the gate.

controls.title: No CODEOWNERS approval dependency
controls.policySection: Fixed context - Do not require human approval
controls.recommendation: Review CODEOWNERS usage without introducing another human merge or deployment gate.

controls.title: Separate release tag creation and immutability rules
controls.recommendation: Review separate v* creation and immutable-tag rules; only the verified GitHub Actions application may bypass creation.

controls.title: Observed exact required check contexts
controls.recommendation: Bind required check names and application identities to observed runs on the exact assessed commit. Review missing or skipped contexts before ruleset changes.

controls.title: GitHub Secret Protection
controls.recommendation: Review GitHub secret scanning and push-protection settings using existing licensed capability; do not substitute duplicate scanners.

controls.title: Explicit bounded workflow permissions
controls.recommendation: Review explicit least-privilege workflow and job permissions; broad write-all permissions are not a safe default.

controls.title: Immutable action references
controls.recommendation: Review immutable action references. The only permitted action-reference exception is the exact official SLSA generator with scoped, expiring approval.

controls.title: Required-job fail-open configuration
controls.policySection: Phase 5 - No required check may fail open
controls.recommendation: Review continue-on-error and unresolved conditions on required jobs. Static inspection does not establish full script failure semantics.

controls.title: Declared security stage and tool inventory
controls.recommendation: Review the canonical GitHub, Checkov, Trivy, report-only Grype, ZAP, attestation and Scorecard roles. Unresolved reusable workflows or scripts need separate evidence.

controls.title: Applicable deployment environments and review gates
controls.recommendation: Review the project's declared environments and GitHub environment restrictions without human reviewer gates.

controls.title: Repository-bound private runner assignment
controls.recommendation: Review the exact hosted-runner, group, network, labels and selected-repository bindings. Assessment does not create or broaden assignments.

controls.title: Required provider registration states
controls.recommendation: Review only the namespaces needed by explicitly bound resources. Provider registration requires a separately approved execution plan.

controls.title: Bound storage redundancy
controls.recommendation: Compare the explicitly bound storage role and environment before planning redundancy changes; never provision an unused service.

controls.title: Explicit private runner egress
controls.policySection: Private Staging runner provisioning contract - explicit outbound mode
controls.recommendation: Review explicit outbound access and mutually exclusive NAT/Firewall routing using validated Staging bindings; never share another repository's firewall.

controls.title: Current authoritative governance evidence
controls.recommendation: Refresh missing or stale proof through supported setup operations after reviewing blockers; reports and task checkboxes are not phase evidence.

controls.title: Required operational and security documentation
controls.recommendation: Review missing governance, scanning, alerting, health, audit-evidence, acceptable-use and rollback runbook documents in a separate project change.

controls.title: Release version and verified attestation binding
controls.expected: verified version, candidate SHA, deployed digest and signer binding
controls.recommendation: Supply independently verifiable release and attestation evidence; file or asset presence alone does not verify provenance.

controls.title: Build-once identical artifact promotion
controls.recommendation: Verify immutable candidate and deployed digest records. Assessment does not build, scan, dispatch, or deploy artifacts.

controls.title: Blue-green and canary execution proof
controls.policySection: Deployment strategy - blue-green mechanism, canary exposure
controls.recommendation: Review real rollout and traffic evidence; declarative files alone do not prove behavior.

controls.title: Ungated rollback rehearsal
controls.expected: dated successful rollback by prior digest
controls.recommendation: Provide rollback rehearsal evidence; assessment never triggers a rollback or adds a reviewer gate.

controls.title: Runtime monitoring and end-to-end alerts
controls.expected: observed health signals and alert delivery
controls.recommendation: Supply verified alert delivery and monitoring evidence without exposing webhook or credential values.

controls.title: Deep dependency health and recovery order
controls.recommendation: Review observed deep health and dependency recovery evidence; do not infer it from endpoint names.

controls.title: Delivery performance measurements
controls.recommendation: Review measured delivery outcomes; no DORA measurement adapter is available in this assessment version.

controls.title: Private DNS and Staging reachability proof
controls.policySection: Private Staging runner provisioning contract - Prove isolation and the private path
controls.expected: live private path proof from the assigned runner
controls.recommendation: Provide current runner-origin private reachability evidence; assessment does not schedule DAST or infer reachability from a VNet.

controls.title: Bootstrap state custody and day-30 disposal
controls.expected: validated encrypted custody and disposal evidence
controls.recommendation: Review non-secret retention and deletion evidence. Assessment never reads state payloads or encryption keys.

controls.title: Deliberate negative required-check proof
controls.expected: green and deliberate red proof for exact required contexts
controls.recommendation: Use existing authoritative negative-test evidence; assessment must not plant violations or trigger validation workflows.
